children: Motilal Oswal's research report on Persistent Systems

Persistent Systems (PSYS) reported a 2QFY27 revenue of USD488m (vs. est. USD475m), up 7.8% QoQ in USD terms and 7.8% in CC terms (est. +5%). EBIT margin stood at 15% (vs. our est. of 15.6%). EBIT grew 1.6%/19.5% QoQ/YoY to INR6.9b. Adj. PAT came in at INR4.9b (vs. our est. of INR5.7b), up 2.2%/4.7% QoQ/YoY. This excludes the Nagarro acquisition-related expenses of INR1.9b (post-tax INR1.4b). For 1HFY27, revenue/adj. EBIT/adj. PAT grew 29.7%/25.7%/9.0% YoY in INR terms.

We expect revenue/adj. EBIT/adj. PAT to grow 26.5%/25.1%/24.8% YoY in 2HFY27. TCV stood at USD634m, down 44.7% QoQ/ up 4.4% YoY (1.3x book-to-bill). We value PSYS at 35x FY28E EPS. We reiterate our BUY rating on the stock with a TP of INR6,700.
